# Appendix B: Support Scripts {#appndx_b}

## [r-global.path.R](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r-global.path.R) Script {#appndx_b.r_global.path}

This script establishes and validates the following paramount `R` scripts' directory paths:

- [root `R` scripts' directory](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/tree/main/r);
- [support scripts' directory](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/tree/main/r/support-scripts);
- [user-defined support (helper) functions' scripts directory](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/tree/main/r/support-functions).


## [setup.R](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-scripts/setup.R) Script {#appndx_b.setup}
\

This script serves as the master initialization and environment-configuration script for the entire project.
Its primary purpose is to set up and configure all software dependencies, Python environments, directory paths, and helper functions before running any project execution scripts.

The [first two lines of the code](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-scripts/setup.R#L5-L6) perform the following operations in order:

1. Adjust the global download timeout to handle packages and large dataset downloads;
2. Increase the expression nesting limit. 

Below is a detailed breakdown of the code by sections.

### [Install Packages](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-scripts/setup.R#L8-L85) Section  
\

The code in this Section automatically checks for required `R` packages across multiple domains and installs them if some or all are not installed.
